brief:
**BLUF:** Today is Election Day across Virginia and West Virginia, with polls open 6 a.m.–7 p.m. local time and strong turnout anticipated in Tazewell County (about 28,500 registered voters) and Mercer County; local races include Tazewell Town Council and federal contests. Tazewell County recently imposed a nine-month data center moratorium through July 2027 to develop regulations. No major law enforcement incidents, fires, or active hazards reported in the core area in the last 24 hours.[[1]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/local-election-officials-anticipate-strong-turnout-at-polls/article_6799ceed-4c0e-48bf-9897-58acd7a017ea.html)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours. A bench warrant list was released by Bluefield WV Police Department on Oct. 30 (names and details available via department channels; individuals can self-surrender). A Mercer County man, Bobby Ray York, 43, of Bramwell, was arrested Oct. 23 on felony domestic violence third offense and remains in Southern Regional Jail with no bond. Princeton WV Police Lt. R.M. Combs was arrested Oct. 28 on first-degree arson related to an August 4 structure fire at 903 Harrison Street in Princeton (investigated by WV State Fire Marshal’s Office; placed on administrative leave).[[2]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bench-warrant-list-released-by-the-bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-55/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours. A Community Foundation grant assisted Richlands EMS (announced Nov. 2).[[3]](https://nextdoor.com/agency-detail/va/tazewell-county/power-outage-alerts-1494/)

**Region:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core:** No active NWS alerts. Recent Appalachian Power outages in Tazewell County (e.g., Raven/Richlands area) have been restored. No VDOT/WVDOH closures reported on US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, or Route 67 in the core.[[3]](https://nextdoor.com/agency-detail/va/tazewell-county/power-outage-alerts-1494/)

**Region:** Nothing significant reported in the last 24 hours.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Election Day today (Nov. 3); Tazewell County voters decide local races including Tazewell Town Council (candidates: Renee Dawn Adair, Glen A. Keen Jr., Carolyn S. Moore, Billy Ray Jeffers) and federal contests (U.S. Senate: Mark Warner vs. Bert Mizusawa; U.S. House 9th District: Morgan Griffith vs. Joy Powers). Tazewell County Board of Supervisors approved a nine-month data center moratorium (effective until July 28, 2027) on Oct. 30 to evaluate zoning and standards. Tazewell County Public Schools launches “attendance assistant” text tool Nov. 4 for family-school communication on absences.[[4]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/tazewell-county-public-schools-to-launch-attendance-assistant/article_2b6a18f3-d5fc-438d-9cf2-ed1858dff3e8.html)

**Region:** Strong turnout expected at polls; Ninth District Traveling Staff Office Hours scheduled for November by Rep. Morgan Griffith. State still considering Bluefield’s opportunity zone designation. Princeton to host 11th annual Veterans’ Breakfast and Stand Down on Nov. 7.[[1]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/local-election-officials-anticipate-strong-turnout-at-polls/article_6799ceed-4c0e-48bf-9897-58acd7a017ea.html)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Virginia coal industry excellence in mining awards announced (Nov. 2). Remote Area Medical free clinic coming to Giles County this weekend.[[5]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/09/town-bluefield-fire-department-seeks-volunteers/)

**Region:** USDA Rural Development announced $804,854 in value-added producer grants (Nov. 2). The Wayfarer Appalachia brings back Mountain Flavors Festival with Food Network chefs.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Election results and any local outcomes (today).
- Tazewell County Public Schools attendance assistant launch (Nov. 4).
- Princeton Veterans’ Breakfast and Stand Down (Nov. 7).
- Ongoing data center moratorium discussions and road safety grant projects in Tazewell County.
